title: KestrelCare Pro Rata Refunds: Time Measure by Registration State
content:
The time used on a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts plan, for a pro rata refund, is measured by the method of the state in which the vehicle is registered on its Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order.

| Registration state | Time fraction |
|---|---|
| Arizona, Colorado | whole months of use over the plan's term months |
| Texas, Florida | whole months of use plus one, over the plan's term months |
| any other state | calendar days of use over the calendar days from the sale date to the expiration date |

**Rule.** For a vehicle registered in Arizona or Colorado on its purchase order, the time fraction is the whole months of use, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached, over the plan's term months; for a vehicle registered in Texas or Florida, it is the whole months of use plus one over the plan's term months; for a vehicle registered in any other state, it is the calendar days of use over the calendar days from the sale date to the expiration date.

- The months or days of use run from the day the plan's use is counted from to the day it is counted to, and are never fewer than zero.
- A month of use is complete only when the same day of the month is reached: use from 15 January to 14 April is 2 whole months; to 15 April it is 3.

## Worked comparison (hypothetical 36-month plan, use from 15 January to 14 April, 89 days, term of 1095 days)

| Registration | Fraction |
|---|---|
| Arizona or Colorado | 2 over 36, about 0.0556 |
| Texas or Florida | 3 over 36, about 0.0833 |
| Georgia | 89 over 1095, about 0.0813 |
